verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is an inference cloud. Operating it through natural-language commands, such as an assistant that manages deployments or account settings, is a fair axis for this kind of product. The evidence only shows an OpenAI-compatible chat API for sending prompts to hosted models, which is a product feature, not natural-language control of DeepInfra itself. No evidence of a natural-language operating interface was found.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
